text:
Introduction
This procedure outlines the testing procedures P1, to be carried out on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Rasha Soliman, 
tested by eng Mohamed Rabee, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Mohamed Abou Aiasha head sector of Damanhour power station and 
and
certified by eng. 
Gaber Farahat 
WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... 
etc
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... 
etc
Unit must be shutdown.
Circuit breaker open and 
 local.
Tools and Equipment
Secondary injection test 
 set .
Suitable tool set.
Avometer, test leads
Work to be carried out
Connect the current test 
 set terminals to point (1-2) .
Connect the timer test 
 set terminal to point (15-16) .
Inject the current then 
 increase the current gradually until the red flag appears then record I (pick 
 - up) and record the time .
Decrease the current 
 gradually until the red flag disappear then record I (reset)
For find the time for 
 trip increase the current until the timer red flag appear them record the time 
 for trip .
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Return relay to service 
 by removing the plug test
Make sure CT secondary 
 circuits are in normal condition.
If any equipment 
 associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service 
 by the following restoration steps:
 * Breaker trip coils
 * Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 * Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with 
 this relay.
 * Make sure CT secondary circuits are in normal 
 condition
Return the work permit.
